  director = 'Sam Bailey, Angela Barnes (showrunner: Chinaka Hodge)',
  `cast` = 'Dominique Thorne as Riri Williams / Ironheart, Anthony Ramos as Parker Robbins / The Hood, Lyric Ross as Natalie Washington',
  tagline = 'Genius has no limits. Riri Williams builds her own legacy in the MCU.',
  description = 'Ironheart follows Riri Williams, the MIT genius introduced in Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, as she returns to her hometown of Chicago and builds her own advanced suit while confronting a villain who wields mystical powers.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/ironheart-featured-4Mz9Gy8z2hYXSCjFbvVJFo.webp',
  episodeCount = 6, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = NULL, rtAudienceScore = NULL, verdict = NULL,
  cardMarketContent = '## Ironheart Cards: The Next Iron Legacy\n\nIronheart cards carry speculative value as Riri Williams is positioned as Tony Stark''s spiritual successor. Dominique Thorne impressed in Wakanda Forever, and her solo series cards will be key for collectors tracking the next generation of MCU heroes.',
  keyCards = '- **2026 Upper Deck Ironheart Riri Williams** — Next-gen Iron hero debut, $8-20 (projected)\n- **2026 Upper Deck Ironheart Anthony Ramos/The Hood** — Musical star villain card, $5-15 (projected)',
  content = '## The Next Iron Legacy\n\nIronheart brings Riri Williams from her impressive Wakanda Forever introduction into her own series. As an MIT genius who builds advanced technology in her Chicago garage, Riri represents the next generation of MCU inventors — carrying Tony Stark''s legacy without trying to replace him.\n\n## Magic Meets Technology\n\nThe show''s unique angle is pitting Riri''s technology against Anthony Ramos'' Hood, a villain who wields mystical powers. This tech-vs-magic dynamic creates a fresh conflict for the MCU and connects Ironheart to the broader magical corner of the universe.\n\n## Fun Facts\n\n- Dominique Thorne was cast before Wakanda Forever was even written\n- The show connects to both the tech and magic sides of the MCU\n- Anthony Ramos brings his Hamilton fame to the MCU as The Hood\n- The series is expected to set up Riri''s role in future Avengers projects',
  metaDescription = 'Ironheart (2025) guide — Riri Williams solo series, tech vs magic, trading card speculation, and the next generation of MCU heroes.',
  keywords = 'ironheart, riri williams, dominique thorne, the hood, anthony ramos, disney plus marvel, marvel cards, iron man legacy',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Ironheart Riri Williams cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Do I need to watch Wakanda Forever before Ironheart?","answer":"Yes, Riri Williams is introduced in Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, which establishes her character, abilities, and connection to Wakandan technology."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'ironheart-2025';

UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'TBD (showrunner: Andrew Guest)',
  `cast` = 'Yahya Abdul-Mateen II as Simon Williams / Wonder Man, Ben Kingsley as Trevor Slattery, Demetrius Grosse as TBD',
  tagline = 'The stunt man becomes the hero. Hollywood meets superpowers in Marvel''s newest series.',
  description = 'Wonder Man follows Simon Williams, a Hollywood stunt man and failed actor who gains ionic powers, navigating the entertainment industry while becoming a superhero, with Trevor Slattery along for the ride.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/wonder-man-featured-3Rr9c7Nt3ixvUZNQqHyqFR.webp',
  episodeCount = 6, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = NULL, rtAudienceScore = NULL, verdict = NULL,
  cardMarketContent = '## Wonder Man Cards: Hollywood Hero Collectibles\n\nWonder Man cards carry speculative value with Yahya Abdul-Mateen II''s star power. Ben Kingsley''s return as Trevor Slattery adds novelty appeal. The character''s connection to Vision in comics makes these cards interesting for long-term MCU speculation.',
  keyCards = '- **2026 Upper Deck Wonder Man Yahya Abdul-Mateen II** — A-list actor debut, $8-20 (projected)\n- **2026 Upper Deck Wonder Man Trevor Slattery** — Ben Kingsley fan-favorite return, $5-12 (projected)',
  content = '## Hollywood Meets Superpowers\n\nWonder Man brings a unique angle to the MCU — a story set in the entertainment industry. Simon Williams as a stunt man who gains powers offers commentary on celebrity, heroism, and the blurred line between performance and reality.\n\n## Trevor Slattery Returns\n\nBen Kingsley''s Trevor Slattery — the fake Mandarin from Iron Man 3 who became a real hero in Shang-Chi — returns as Simon''s companion. Their dynamic promises to be one of the MCU''s most entertaining odd couples.\n\n## Fun Facts\n\n- Yahya Abdul-Mateen II is known for Watchmen and Aquaman\n- The show is described as a Hollywood satire with superhero elements\n- Wonder Man has deep connections to Vision in the comics\n- Ben Kingsley''s Trevor Slattery has become an unexpected fan-favorite across multiple films',
  metaDescription = 'Wonder Man (2026) guide — Simon Williams origin, Hollywood setting, Trevor Slattery return, trading card speculation, and MCU expansion.',
  keywords = 'wonder man, simon williams, yahya abdul-mateen, trevor slattery, ben kingsley, disney plus marvel, marvel cards, hollywood',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Wonder Man cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Who is Wonder Man in the comics?","answer":"Simon Williams/Wonder Man is an ionic-powered hero with deep connections to the Avengers. In comics, his brain patterns were used to create Vision, making them essentially brothers."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'wonder-man-2026'
